title: chrysopogon elongatus
intro: Chrysopogon elongatus, commonly known as Vetiver, is a type of perennial grass native to India and parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Vetiver include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Vetiver include essential oils such as vetiverol and vetiverone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
